item.title: Nicki Minaj’s MAGA Turn Culminates In Appearance With Erika Kirk At Turning Point Festival
item.description: It's not necessarily surprising that rapper Nicki Minaj has been cuddling up to MAGA, but that doesn't make it any less unsettling. She's become more and more vocally supportive of the current White House administration. Today, she was the surprise guest at Turning Points USA's AmericaFest in Arizona, where she was interviewed by Charlie Kirk's widow Erika Kirk. item.title: Bob Dylan Explains Willie Nelson
item.description: Willie Nelson is the subject of a new profile in The New Yorker today.
